project_tracker_diagnostic: Annual; lower leaves opposite and upper leaves alternate; blades 1–2-pinnately lobed; male heads form terminal spikes and female heads sit below in leaf axils.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common, conspicuous, or high-value comparison species for Central Texas field ID.

morphology_keys.habit: Erect, branching herb of disturbed ground.
morphology_keys.leaves: Lower leaves opposite, upper leaves alternate; blades deltate to lanceolate, 1–2-pinnately lobed, gland-dotted.
morphology_keys.flowers: Separate male and female heads on the same plant; male heads in terminal spikes/racemes, female heads clustered below.
morphology_keys.fruit: Small burs, roughly globose to pear-shaped, with 3–5 short spines/tubercles.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
